scope: Capture integrity, not visual acceptance or performance

daytimePreservation.scope: Full RGB frames before/after storm finite-path correction

regressionLimit: Regression views precede the final foam-coordinate correction; optical and cloud source is identical.

irradiance.tolerance: Isotropic: 0.15% includes binary16 rounding. Linear angular gradient: 0.8% includes finite 128-point quadrature and 32-pixel cubemap sampling. Analytic E(n)=pi*(0.5+n/6).

coupling.tolerance: Absolute amplitude 0.0003; derivative 0.00015 per metre. Includes binary16 samples and bilinear gradient changes across a 4.31 m cell; reference is analytic, not copied sampler code.
coupling.scope: Manufactured long-wave convergence field. Not observational validation of the bounded modulation model.

waveVisibility.reference: Dense CPU analytic sinusoid intersection at 0.0625 m intervals. Not a duplicate of the logarithmic GPU ray traversal.
waveVisibility.tolerance: Classification only outside 0.15/0.30 m transition margins. Margins cover finite solar radius, 0.065 m near bias and far atlas interpolation error (~0.15 m for this wavelength).
waveVisibility.limitations: Manufactured one-dimensional waves. Production inversion at folds and two-dimensional storm silhouettes remain separate visual/numerical gates.

lensMedium.tolerance: 0.15 mm signed-height error: binary16 input/output, texture interpolation and 0.0833 m raster triangles on a 7.43 m sinusoid. Linear mesh interpolation bound A*k^2*spacing^2/8 is 0.075 mm; remaining budget covers quantization and texture sampling. Constant translation inversion residual <0.01 mm.
lensMedium.scope: Production near-plane shader, flat/curved/translated manufactured surfaces against an analytic sinusoid. Does not certify inversion at folded storm crests or coarser/morphed raster nodes.

coordinates.tolerance: 0.12 mm phase-equivalent position error and 0.0025 unit-sinusoid amplitude error. Bounds cover f32 local-coordinate rounding, inverse length and UV multiply/add across 512 m; CPU reference uses double global modulo.
coordinates.scope: Production UV helper on native GPU, six cascade periods, global origins through 1e9 m. Does not validate remote atmosphere precision or all material motion across rebases.
